annotation.bound_parties_text: The Decree binds the Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources, heads of central administrative agencies, Mayors/Do Governors, project implementers, persons operating safety-certified outdoor mobile robots, specialized intelligent robot enterprises, and research institutes.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: A person who intends to operate an outdoor mobile robot with safety certification shall purchase a liability insurance policy, etc. pursuant to Article 40-4 of the Act, before operating such robot.
annotation.dates_quote: This Decree shall enter into force on December 13, 2018.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE INTELLIGENT ROBOTS DEVELOPMENT AND DISTRIBUTION PROMOTION ACT Presidential Decree No. 29343, Dec. 11, 2018
